capabilities: Chat with the local pi coding agent in a right-sidebar panel
Spawn pi as a subprocess and stream its text and tool calls
Expose vault files, search, tags, and backlinks over a local HTTP endpoint
Optionally let pi create or modify notes (writes off by default)
Configure pi executable path, model provider, and forbidden paths
disambiguation: Not a general AI chat plugin; it only talks to the pi coding agent running on the same machine.
extras: Unreviewed by Obsidian staff; README explains three intentional linter warnings (direct filesystem access, shell execution, vault enumeration) and notes Allow writes is off by default; troubleshooting details live in a separate TROUBLESHOOTING.md.
intentEvidence: obsidian-copilot-style multi-agent routing is out of scope here — this plugin talks to one agent (pi)
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with a locally running AI coding agent and let that agent read or search vault notes.

requires.name: model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, local, etc.) configured in pi

summary: AI chat panel that runs the local pi coding agent as a subprocess and exposes the vault over a local HTTP server so it can read notes via curl.
